versions.content: {DRAFT} The Ethernet switch configuration shall support a port based configuration at ingress side to assign an outbound VLAN pri- ority to incoming Ethernet frames according to their regenerated VLAN priority (a.k.a. PCP field, see [SWS_EthSwt_00178]), i.e. an outbound VLAN priority assignment can be configured (see EthSwtPortOutboundVlanPriorityAssignment , Eth- SwtPriorityRegeneratedIngressVlanPriority , and EthSwtPriorityOut- boundVlanPriority ).
